body: The map is folded toward its road line; the keyring lies beyond the fold, its tag turned face down. A short length of thread joins them but does not reach the road.
title: The key points past the marked road

body: “Forget the box. Just get here before the rows are watered.” The lower half is torn away; a muddy thumb has blurred the place where a name would go.
title: The note that asks someone to come back
